title: The Panama Canal: from a French failure to Panamanian control
goal: Tell the history of the canal, from 1881 to 1999, with antes de que and después de que.
grammar: clauses with antes de que and despues de que

sections.title: The Panama Canal: from a French failure to Panamanian control
body: In this lesson you follow the canal from the French attempt of 1881 to the day in 1999 when Panama took it over. You will also read about the canal in the news in 2023-2025.
The grammar is one you know: clauses with *antes de que* and *después de que*. The screens and instructions are in English; the readings are in Spanish.

items: I can say what happened before or after an event in the history of the canal, with *antes de que* and *después de que*.
I can say what happened on 31 December 1999.
I can use the new words for treaties, locks and sovereignty.
